proof:
*-distribʳ-+ : _*_ DistributesOverʳ _+_
*-distribʳ-+ m zero    o = refl
*-distribʳ-+ m (suc n) o = begin-equality
  (suc n + o) * m     ≡⟨⟩
  m + (n + o) * m     ≡⟨ cong (m +_) (*-distribʳ-+ m n o) ⟩
  m + (n * m + o * m) ≡⟨ sym (+-assoc m (n * m) (o * m)) ⟩
  m + n * m + o * m   ≡⟨⟩
  suc n * m + o * m   ∎

clauses.goal: (zero + o) * m ≡ zero * m + o * m

steps.statement: (zero + o) * m ≡ zero * m + o * m
steps.head: refl

clauses.goal: (suc n + o) * m ≡ suc n * m + o * m

steps.statement: (suc n + o) * m ≡ m + (n + o) * m
m + (n + o) * m ≡ m + (n * m + o * m)
steps.head: *-distribʳ-+

steps.statement: m + (n * m + o * m) ≡ m + n * m + o * m
steps.head: +-assoc

steps.statement: m + n * m + o * m ≡ suc n * m + o * m

lemma_normal.+-assoc: (x y z : ℕ) → x + y + z ≡ x + (y + z)
